aboutMe.title: About Me
paragraphs: I keep [B]computing solutions asynchronously[/B] until a problem is fully resolved — after work, while sleeping, in the middle of the night. When something is unclear, I design an experiment or dig into the source directly.

I don't sit on what I find. I believe [B]documentation and sharing is the most effective form of communication[/B]. I've written up analyses that changed my team's technical direction, and filed open source issues from findings along the way. A personal discovery becoming a team-level change is the kind of impact I find most rewarding.

When opinions clash, [B]I start by assuming I might be wrong[/B]. If we're aiming at the same goal, the other person's argument always has a reason behind it. I analyze, look at it from their perspective, and then talk.
I'm always [B]conscious of the tradeoff between time and quality[/B]. I don't chase perfect code — I chase the right code for where the product is.

details.text:
Adding mobile and other environments meant test count would scale linearly
	set up parallel execution with [B]Dynamic metric + Playwright Sharding[/B], reducing average test time by [B]67.7%[/B] ([L:https://team.allrafintech.co.kr/frontend-playwright-e2e-test-ci-optimization-d94b082509d8]blog[/L])

ESLint and Prettier each traverse the AST separately, costing ~2 min per CI lint run
	replaced the entire pipeline with [B]Biome[/B], reducing average CI lint time by [B]98%[/B]

Datadog pricing change made the monitoring tool unsustainable
	led [B]gradual OpenReplay migration[/B] in collaboration with the DevOps team. While configuring the CI/CD sourcemap upload pipeline, discovered and reported a bug in OpenReplay's own codebase via [L:https://github.com/openreplay/openreplay/issues/4476]open source contribution[/L]

Pre-settlement page has multiple login-style forms coexisting, Chrome autofill was polluting all of them
	Traced the root cause through Chrome CPP source, resolved with a [B]Honeypot decoy field to suppress autofill[/B]

In the pre-settlement flow, child components were each mutating state via [B]useEffect[/B], and accumulated business rules made the branching unmanageable
	moved all calculation into a Provider and delivered state as a [B]Discriminated Union[/B], leaving children to render only. Backed the refactor with unit tests for stability

Server Action-based architecture caused slow page loads and repeated build failures
	dug into the root cause, [B]documented the sequential execution constraint[/B], shared with the team ([L:https://codefug.github.io/posts/2026-01-29]blog[/L]), [B]proposed and led tRPC migration[/B]

Discovered a deep-copy bug that was silently preventing per-page metadata overrides
	traced the root cause, fixed it, and unified all page OG/Twitter metadata into [B]shared utils[/B] to prevent recurrence

Collaborated with the marketing team on SEO quality improvements
	introduced [B]Schema.org JSON-LD structured data[/B] to enhance search engine crawling quality

CRA deprecated and no longer receiving security updates, flagged under internal security policy
	[B]CRA → Vite migration[/B] resolved the risk and reduced bundle size [B]1200kB → 500kB (58.3%)[/B]

Existing editor incompatible with in-house [B]CSP policy[/B]
	migrated to react-quill-new and built a custom image resize module to resolve security violations
